studios.name: Strawberry Studios
studios.description: This old cinema has been a studio for thirty years and has a lot of tradition. Nowadays, the equipment isn't perfectly up-to-date, but the famous sound is still there.

studios.name: Garage Studio
studios.description: Worn-down, tobacco-smelling underground studio with equipment well past its sell by date. Many rockers get a nostalgic feeling when they hear the name.

labels.name: Rebel Records
labels.description: Small label on a perpetual uphill-struggle. Run by aging enthusiasts.

labels.name: Rainbow Records
labels.description: Small record label that started out as an underground music movement in the seventies. Maybe a bit too nice for their own good.
